purpose: Define the working admission boundary for Savlivo's target consumer-service universe.

service_size.rule: At least 100,000 documented users, members, customers, subscribers, or active users attributable to the service itself.
not_sufficient_alone: parent-company/group customer count not attributable to the service
notes: 100,000 is the current working threshold and may be revised by a later manifest version.
The threshold applies to the service total; it need not be met separately in every country.

monthly_recurring.rule: At least one genuine consumer subscription or membership must have a recurring monthly provider billing cadence.
qualifies: service with both monthly and annual options when at least one legitimate monthly recurring offer exists
does_not_qualify: monthly-equivalent presentation when actual billing/commitment is non-monthly
installment arithmetic that is not a genuine monthly recurring provider charge
generic recurrence without established monthly cadence

account_login.rule: The subscriber can log in to an account associated with the service.

membership_management.rule: After login, the subscriber can manage the subscription or membership.
membership_management.note: Cancellation is tracked separately and is not made an admission requirement by this manifest.

geography.rule: A service may exist in only one country and qualify. Geographic breadth is not an admission criterion.
geography.market_availability: Market applicability is researched separately after service qualification.

rules: Provider-price verification is not service admission.
Annual/non-monthly prices may remain contextual evidence but cannot establish monthly-recurring admission.
A monthly equivalent is not a provider-billed monthly recurring price.
Provider-derived recurring price 0 is never a valid final recurring provider price or suggested recurring price.
User-entered pricing remains separate from provider-price verification.

qualifies_when: at least one genuine monthly recurring consumer offer is established
subscription/membership management after login is established
decision.unknown_policy: Missing evidence remains unresolved/unknown; it is not silently treated as proof of qualification or disqualification.

architecture_principle: Operator controls permissions. V2 controls routing. Verifier controls what becomes evidence.

evidence_policy.rule: Three sufficiently strong, relevant, independent proofs converging on the same proposition establish that proposition as VERIFIED/ESTABLISHED.
evidence_policy.persistence: Once VERIFIED/ESTABLISHED, the proposition remains established until relevant contradictory evidence is actually established.
evidence_policy.independence: Correlated, duplicated, derivative, or materially dependent observations must not be counted as independent proofs.
evidence_policy.contradiction_rule: Only relevant evidence that materially contradicts the established proposition may trigger re-evaluation, downgrade, or reversal.
evidence_policy.semantic_sufficiency: The three-proof rule does not override dimension-specific truth requirements. Three insufficient or semantically invalid proofs cannot establish a proposition.
